### Install

```sh
npm install -g https://github.com/zalos/farsight/releases/download/v0.1.2/farsight-cli-0.1.2.tgz
farsight --version   # farsight 0.1.2 · built … · commit …
```

Needs Node 24 or newer. Then follow [Getting started](https://github.com/zalos/farsight/blob/v0.1.2/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md).
